reviews.t: Ok Quality, pattern comes off easily.
reviews.x: Ok quality.  Printed pattern is on one side and comes off if you use that side...gross.  So, they're 50% effective.  Fast shipping and got what was promised, just disappointed in the product received, even for the price.

reviews.t: Great files! Another review mentioned that the design comes ...
reviews.x: Great files!  Another review mentioned that the design comes off eventually.  That hasn't happened but if it does, I don't care.  These little nail files work beautifully.

reviews.t: Good Nail Files for a Good Price
reviews.x: These glass nail files arrived in good condition, as promised.  They work well--yes, the design does come off after use, but I didn't buy them for their pretty designs.  The price is quite cheap for 5 of them and allows me to have them spread around in many places (purses, the car, the bedroom, the living room, etc.)  My nails are very brittle and chip easily so having a handy glass nail file is a must.  The old "emory boards" just tear my nails up.

written my wife of account holder: these are very pretty and they work great! they are supposed to all have cases and i was one case short but i don't mind because, when i quit using one of them, i will just use the case for the other. it will equal out. the thing i don't like is that the colors on the files bleed on to the case but that is such a small thing. these would be cute to give to friends as just a little token. i love them! my MIL had bought me a glass nail file years ago at Hallmark.

I agree with the other reviewer that said these are low quality.  I love crystal nail files, I wanted my friend to try them so I got these.  Normal glass files just glide across hardly making noise as they go overnight  your nails. They leave a smooth finish. These are rough and abrasive.  They sound crunchy like all the other files out there.  I'm really disappointed

reviews.t: one star because all though these are great the shipping is horrible
reviews.x: one star because all though these are great the shipping is horrible. I ordered several set but only have one that arrived. I'm on a schedule and I'm stressing over nail files! I wanted to use them along with other products as thank yous for a bridal shower. I hope I get the rest of them soon.

I really liked them! This was the first time I've used glass files. They are much better than the cheap disposable ones, that goes without saying. But I like them even better than the metal ones I've used for years. They are firmer and stronger, but also very smooth when filing.

They are cute and small like I wanted, but I was robbed of one.  I only received 4 instead of 5, which is why I'm not giving a better rating. The pattern comes random so all mine weren't that pretty. However, I still like them.
Thicker than I usually like, but I haven’t broken one yet. Each has a plastic sleeve that keeps it safe in my purse and when I dropped it. So far so good

reviews.t: Don’t buy if you’re looking for quality
reviews.x: I got these to use for my business as little gifts and they aren’t very good quality at all - the grit is not even and doesn’t last long. I tried one out myself and could hardly get through one manicure on my nails before it stopped working!

reviews.t: Best finger nail file that I have ever used
reviews.x: Best finger nail file that I have ever used!...I give them away as gifts and every-one that I gave one to absolutely Loves them and they told me that they are the best nail files that they have ever used also! Love them!
These are terrible. I bought a different set of glass nail files that were amazing. These are not. They don’t file well and leave the nail feeling rough.
Nice pattern selection and not too big or small. Does a better filing job than the classic paper sticks.
I received the package today however there was a couple damaged (broken) files!  😥
So cute and work well. Came way earlier then expected too
Great quality mini files!! Designs are super cute too!
Very poor quality. Useless after a couple of filings.
I only trust the ones made in Czechoslovakia.

reviews.t: Great mini-size. Grit doesn't last long
reviews.x: Pros: Great size, perfect for my desk and bedstand and car, etc.  Eh: The patterns are "eh," some suck and some are decent.  Cons: The grit wears out very quickly. Faster than a regular cardboard/foam emery board. That sucks. I was hoping that the glass version was an option that would be more durable and last longer. But, sadly, it is not. I'd say within a week, I had worn both sides down on at least 3 of these, so it is now just smooth glass in those spots .... I was willing to make an investm

reviews.t: I wear natural nails and the average file tears my nails up something terrible, causing splitting & cracking
reviews.x: Cute, but still a bit too harsh. I ordered because i purchased a crystal file at CVS & they don't carry it anymore & i can't recall the manufacturer.  I wear natural nails and the average file tears my nails up something terrible, causing splitting & cracking.  This doesn't quite do it. But if you have acrylic i guess it'd work out.

Love glass files. I get them every year in various at a local craft fair for myself and gifts. This is a great price for a handful to tuck into the car, locker, desk, ... They last forever and give smooth, clean results.

File feels a little rough but works just fine. You get a random assortment. And they all come with sleeves. I left one at work, in the car, in the bathroom and in my purse. Now I'll always have a nail file on hand.
For the price these work well.  They are small enough to carry in my purse or makeup bag.  The colors on them come off on their plastic case when it gets hot.  But otherwise the work well.
Very nice small glass nail files with plastic covers. They are very attractive and etched on both sides allowing filing on both sides. They arrived quickly and in excellent condition.
This is my first time trying out glass files and am impressed. The designs are cute too. Would be nice if you could pick which ones you got but they just send 5 random ones.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the files work well and file nails smoothly, often preferring them to metal or paper files.
Several reviewers note the printed pattern/design comes off with use, though some say it doesn't bother them.
Some reviewers report receiving fewer files than expected or damaged/broken files.
A number of reviewers complain about poor quality, saying the grit is uneven, rough, or doesn't last.
Reviewers frequently describe the files as cute, pretty, and good value for the price.
